C0001.title: TCS Control Channel A Valve 1
C0001.plain: Fault on traction control system control channel A valve 1.

C0002.title: TCS Control Channel A Valve 2
C0002.plain: Fault on traction control system control channel A valve 2.

C0003.title: TCS Control Channel B Valve 1
C0003.plain: Fault on traction control system control channel B valve 1.

C0004.title: TCS Control Channel B Valve 2
C0004.plain: Fault on traction control system control channel B valve 2.

C0010.title: Left Front Inlet Control
C0010.plain: Fault on left front ABS inlet (apply) valve.

C0011.title: Left Front Outlet Control
C0011.plain: Fault on left front ABS outlet (release) valve.

C0012.title: Left Front Hydraulic Release Too Long
C0012.plain: Hydraulic release on left front wheel circuit took longer than expected.
causes: Outlet valve sluggish or hydraulic restriction

C0014.title: Right Front Inlet Control
C0014.plain: Fault on right front ABS inlet (apply) valve.

C0015.title: Right Front Outlet Control
C0015.plain: Fault on right front ABS outlet (release) valve.

C0016.title: Right Front Hydraulic Release Too Long
C0016.plain: Hydraulic release on right front wheel circuit took longer than expected.
causes: Outlet valve sluggish or hydraulic restriction

C0018.title: Left Rear Inlet Control
C0018.plain: Fault on left rear ABS inlet (apply) valve.

C0019.title: Left Rear Outlet Control
C0019.plain: Fault on left rear ABS outlet (release) valve.

C001A.title: Left Rear Hydraulic Release Too Long
C001A.plain: Hydraulic release on left rear wheel circuit took longer than expected.
causes: Outlet valve sluggish or hydraulic restriction

C001C.title: Right Rear Inlet Control
C001C.plain: Fault on right rear ABS inlet (apply) valve.

C001D.title: Right Rear Outlet Control
C001D.plain: Fault on right rear ABS outlet (release) valve.

C001E.title: Right Rear Hydraulic Release Too Long
C001E.plain: Hydraulic release on right rear wheel circuit took longer than expected.
causes: Outlet valve sluggish or hydraulic restriction

C0020.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit
C0020.plain: The ABS control module detects an electrical fault in the pump motor circuit. Without a working pump, the system cannot build hydraulic pressure for ABS or stability control interventions and disables those functions.
causes: Pump motor seized after long inactivity
Pump motor relay welded or open

C0021.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit Range/Performance
C0021.plain: The pump motor responds, but its current draw or run time is outside the expected range. The control module suspects mechanical wear or hydraulic blockage.
causes: Hydraulic block contaminated with brake fluid debris
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0022.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit Low
C0022.plain: Voltage on the pump motor control line is below threshold. Typical causes are a short to ground or interrupted positive supply.
causes: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0023.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit High
C0023.plain: Voltage on the pump motor control line is above the expected range, typically caused by a short to battery voltage or a stuck relay.
causes: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0024.title: Brake Pedal Feedback Pressure Solenoid Circuit
C0024.plain: Fault on brake pedal feedback pressure solenoid — used in brake-by-wire systems to provide pedal feel.

C0025.title: ABS Pump Motor Stalled
C0025.plain: The pump motor draws current but does not rotate. Self-test detects a stalled rotor and disables ABS and stability control.

C0030.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
C0030.plain: The signal from the left front wheel speed sensor is implausible relative to the other wheels. Typical causes are excessive air gap, contaminated tone ring or partial sensor failure.
causes: Metal debris on tone ring (magnetic encoder)

C0031.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Low
C0031.plain: Voltage on the left front wheel speed sensor circuit is below the expected range. The fault is typically caused by a short to ground or an open in the supply line.
causes: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0032.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit High
C0032.plain: Voltage on the left front wheel speed sensor circuit is above the expected range, typically due to a short to battery voltage.
causes: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0033.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
C0033.plain: The control module sees erratic pulses from the left front wheel speed sensor at speed. Common cause is metallic debris on a magnetic encoder or a damaged tone ring.
causes: Tone ring cracked or missing teeth
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0034.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor No Signal
C0034.plain: No pulses are received from the left front wheel speed sensor while other wheels report motion. The fault disables ABS and stability control.

C0035.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0035.plain: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the left front wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.
causes: Tone ring (reluctor) damaged or contaminated with debris
Wiring break or chafe at wheel arch
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

C0036.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
C0036.plain: Intermittent open or short detected on the left front wheel speed sensor circuit. Often caused by chafed wiring or a loose connector.
causes: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0037.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor
C0037.plain: Generic fault on left rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0038.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Supply
C0038.plain: Fault on left rear wheel speed sensor supply circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0039.title: Right Rear Tone Wheel
C0039.plain: Fault detected on right rear tone wheel (pulse ring).

C003A.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor
C003A.plain: Generic fault on right rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003B.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Supply
C003B.plain: Fault on right rear wheel speed sensor supply circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003C.title: Rear Tone Wheel
C003C.plain: Fault on shared rear tone wheel (single rear sensor on solid axle).

C003D.title: Rear Wheel Speed Sensor
C003D.plain: Generic fault on shared rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003E.title: Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Supply
C003E.plain: Fault on rear wheel speed sensor supply circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003F.title: Wheel Speed Sensors Rotation Direction Correlation
C003F.plain: Wheel speed sensors disagree on rotation direction — typically detected when reversing. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0040.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0040.plain: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the right front wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.
causes: Wiring break or chafe at wheel arch
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

C0041.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
C0041.plain: The right front wheel speed signal is implausible compared with other wheels. Typical causes mirror C0030.
causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0042.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Low
C0042.plain: Voltage in the right front wheel speed sensor circuit is below threshold, typically a short to ground.
causes: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0043.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit High
C0043.plain: Voltage in the right front wheel speed sensor circuit is above threshold, typically a short to battery.
causes: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0044.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
C0044.plain: Erratic pulses on the right front wheel speed sensor at speed. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.
causes: Encoder ring contaminated with metal debris
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0045.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0045.plain: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.
causes: Wiring break or chafe under chassis
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

C0046.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
C0046.plain: Intermittent open or short on the right front wheel speed sensor circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.
causes: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0047.title: Brake Booster Pressure Sensor
C0047.plain: Generic fault on brake booster pressure sensor. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

C0048.title: Brake Booster Travel Sensor
C0048.plain: Generic fault on brake booster travel/position sensor. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

C0049.title: Brake Fluid Level
C0049.plain: Brake fluid level low — typically detected by reservoir float switch.
causes: Low brake fluid (leak or pad wear)

C004A.title: Brake Lining Wear Sensor
C004A.plain: Brake lining wear sensor reports thin pads.

C004B.title: Brake Fluid Level Sensor/Switch Circuit/Open
C004B.plain: Open circuit on brake fluid level sensor or switch.
causes: Pin pushed back out of connector body
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor

C004C.title: Brake Booster Motor A Position Sensor Exceeded Learning Limit
C004C.plain: Brake booster motor A position sensor learned offset exceeded the allowed range. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

C004D.title: Brake System Pressure Slow Response
C004D.plain: Brake system pressure response slower than expected.

C004E.title: Brake System Pressure Control Valve Actuator Stuck
C004E.plain: Brake system pressure control valve actuator stuck mechanically.

C004F.title: ABS Control Module Over Temperature
C004F.plain: ABS control module exceeded its safe operating temperature.
causes: Thermal overload from extended ABS use

C0050.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0050.plain: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.
causes: Wiring break or chafe under chassis
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

C0051.title: Power Steering Position Sensor Performance
C0051.plain: The chassis or power steering control module has detected that the steering position signal is implausible compared to vehicle motion. Stability control may be limited because correct yaw and slip-angle calculation depends on a valid steering angle.
causes: Steering angle sensor not calibrated after alignment or repair
Signal path through clock spring degraded

C0052.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Low
C0052.plain: Voltage in the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit is below the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.
causes: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0053.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit High
C0053.plain: Voltage in the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit is above the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.
causes: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0054.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
C0054.plain: Erratic pulses from the left rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.
causes: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0055.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor No Signal
C0055.plain: No pulses received from the left rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0056.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
C0056.plain: Intermittent open or short on the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.
causes: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0060.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit
C0060.plain: The ABS control module detects a fault in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. ABS and stability control are deactivated.

C0061.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
C0061.plain: The right rear wheel speed signal is implausible compared to the other wheels. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.
causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0062.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Low
C0062.plain: Voltage in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit is below the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.
causes: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0063.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit High
C0063.plain: Voltage in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit is above the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.
causes: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0064.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
C0064.plain: Erratic pulses from the right rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.
causes: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0065.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor No Signal
C0065.plain: No pulses received from the right rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0066.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
C0066.plain: Intermittent open or short on the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.
causes: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0069.title: Yaw Rate/Longitude Sensors
C0069.plain: Generic fault on yaw rate/longitudinal acceleration sensor cluster.

C006A.title: Multi-axis Acceleration Sensor
C006A.plain: Generic fault on multi-axis acceleration sensor (combines lateral, longitudinal and vertical accelerations).

C006B.title: Stability System Active Too Long
C006B.plain: Electronic stability control intervened for an excessive duration.
causes: Extended intervention from low traction or driver behavior

C006C.title: Stability System
C006C.plain: Generic fault in electronic stability control system.

C0070.title: Vehicle Speed Sensor Circuit
C0070.plain: The chassis controller detects a fault in the dedicated vehicle speed sensor circuit (when present in addition to wheel speed sensors).

C0072.title: Brake Temperature Too High
C0072.plain: Brake temperature exceeded safe operating limit — risk of brake fade.
causes: Hard or prolonged braking, mountain descent

C0073.title: Delivered Driving Torque
C0073.plain: Engine-delivered driving torque does not match TCS request.

C0074.title: Requested Driving Torque
C0074.plain: Driving torque request from TCS rejected or out of range.

C0075.title: Brake Pedal Position Performance
C0075.plain: Brake pedal position sensor reading implausible.

C0076.title: PWM for Traction Control
C0076.plain: PWM communication signal for traction control faulty.

C0077.title: Low Tire Pressure
C0077.plain: Tire pressure monitoring system detected low tire pressure.

C0078.title: Tire Diameter
C0078.plain: Detected wheel speed implies tire diameter outside expected range — typically wrong tire size or mismatched tires.

C0079.title: Variable Effort Steering
C0079.plain: Generic fault on variable effort steering (VES) system.

C0080.title: Wheel Speed Mismatch (Front Axle)
C0080.plain: Front axle wheel speeds differ beyond the plausibility threshold over time. Often caused by mismatched tyre rolling circumference or a partially failing sensor.
causes: Mixed tyre sizes or worn tyre on one side

C0081.title: Wheel Speed Mismatch (Rear Axle)
C0081.plain: Rear axle wheel speeds differ beyond the plausibility threshold. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0082.title: Brake System Malfunction Indicator
C0082.plain: Brake system malfunction indicator circuit fault.

C0084.title: Traction Active Indicator
C0084.plain: Traction control active indicator lamp circuit fault.

C0085.title: Traction Disable Indicator
C0085.plain: Traction control disable indicator lamp circuit fault.

C0086.title: Vehicle Dynamics Indicator
C0086.plain: Vehicle dynamics control indicator lamp circuit fault.

C008A.title: TCS Mode Control
C008A.plain: Fault on TCS mode control input (offroad/sport mode etc.).

C0090.title: Hydraulic Brake Pressure Sensor Circuit
C0090.plain: The brake pressure sensor in the master cylinder or hydraulic block reports an implausible signal or no signal. The fault disables ABS, stability control and brake assist.

C0091.title: Hydraulic Brake Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
C0091.plain: The brake pressure sensor signal is outside the plausibility band relative to pedal application. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0092.title: 4WD/AWD Power Transfer Unit Position Sensor B
C0092.plain: Fault on 4WD/AWD power transfer unit (PTU) position sensor B.

C0094.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Temperature Sensor
C0094.plain: Fault on rear differential unit temperature sensor.

C0095.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A
C0095.plain: Fault on rear differential unit actuator A.

C0096.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Data
C0096.plain: Rear differential actuator A data implausible or out of range.

C0097.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B
C0097.plain: Fault on rear differential unit actuator B.

C0098.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Data
C0098.plain: Rear differential actuator B data implausible or out of range.

C0099.title: ABS Control Module Internal Fault
C0099.plain: The ABS control module fails its internal self-test (RAM, ROM or processor watchdog). ABS and stability control are disabled.

C009A.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor B
C009A.plain: Fault on rear differential actuator A position sensor B.

C009B.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor C
C009B.plain: Fault on rear differential actuator A position sensor C.

C009C.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor Correlation
C009C.plain: Position sensors on rear differential actuator A disagree.

C009D.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor A
C009D.plain: Fault on rear differential actuator B position sensor A.

C009E.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor B
C009E.plain: Fault on rear differential actuator B position sensor B.

C009F.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor C
C009F.plain: Fault on rear differential actuator B position sensor C.

C00A0.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor Correlation
C00A0.plain: Position sensors on rear differential actuator B disagree.

C00A1.title: Driveline Control Module
C00A1.plain: Generic fault on driveline control module.

C00A2.title: Driveline Control Module Power Transfer Unit Control Circuit Driver
C00A2.plain: Fault on driveline control module driver for PTU control circuit.

C00A3.title: Driveline Control Module Rear Differential Unit A Control Circuit Driver
C00A3.plain: Fault on driveline control module driver for rear differential unit A.

C00A4.title: Driveline Control Module Rear Differential Unit B Control Circuit Driver
C00A4.plain: Fault on driveline control module driver for rear differential unit B.

C00A5.title: Driveline Control Module Transfer Case Unit Control Circuit Driver
C00A5.plain: Fault on driveline control module driver for transfer case unit.

C00A6.title: 4WD/AWD Transfer Case Unit Actuator
C00A6.plain: Fault on transfer case unit actuator.

C00A7.title: 4WD/AWD Transfer Case Unit Actuator Position Sensor A
C00A7.plain: Fault on transfer case actuator position sensor A.

C00A8.title: 4WD/AWD Transfer Case Unit Actuator Position Sensor B
C00A8.plain: Fault on transfer case actuator position sensor B.

C0110.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit Malfunction
C0110.plain: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the hydraulic pump motor circuit. The pump rebuilds brake pressure during ABS regulation — without it, ABS and stability control are disabled.
causes: ABS pump motor failed (worn brushes, seized)
Power supply wiring or fuse fault

C0111.title: ABS Activation Excessively Long
C0111.plain: ABS regulation has been active longer than the allowed duration during a single brake event, suggesting a sensor or hydraulic problem.

C0112.title: ABS Activation Frequency Too High
C0112.plain: ABS regulation cycles activate more frequently than the plausibility model allows.

C0121.title: Valve Relay Circuit Malfunction
C0121.plain: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the valve relay circuit, which supplies power to the ABS solenoid valves. With this fault, the module cannot energize the valves and ABS is disabled.
causes: Power supply wiring or fuse fault

C0128.title: Low Brake Fluid Indicated
C0128.plain: The brake fluid level switch in the master cylinder reservoir reports a low level. ABS and stability control may be deactivated as a precaution.
causes: Worn brake pads (fluid drops as pistons extend)

C0131.title: Master Cylinder Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
C0131.plain: The ABS or stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the master cylinder brake pressure sensor. This sensor reports driver brake input and is used by ABS and ESP for control decisions.
causes: Air in brake system causing erratic pressure

C0136.title: Stop Lamp Switch Circuit
C0136.plain: The ABS or stability control module sees an implausible brake light switch signal. Stability and brake assist functions can be limited until the fault is cleared.

C0141.title: Left Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit
C0141.plain: Left Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.
causes: Inlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0146.title: Left Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit
C0146.plain: Left Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.
causes: Outlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0148.title: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid B Circuit Malfunction
C0148.plain: The ABS module has detected an electrical fault in the secondary outlet solenoid for the right front wheel. ABS and stability control are disabled while the fault is active.
causes: Outlet solenoid valve failed (open or shorted)
Internal fault in ABS hydraulic unit

C0151.title: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit
C0151.plain: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.
causes: Inlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0153.title: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid B Circuit Malfunction
C0153.plain: Electrical fault in the secondary inlet solenoid for the right front wheel. Pressure modulation for that wheel is no longer possible and ABS is disabled.

C0156.title: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit
C0156.plain: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.
causes: Outlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0158.title: Left Rear ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0158.plain: Electrical fault in the inlet solenoid for the left rear wheel. ABS is disabled and the warning lamp is illuminated.

C0161.title: ABS/TCS Brake Switch Circuit
C0161.plain: The ABS or traction control module has detected an implausible signal from the brake light switch. The switch tells the module whether the driver is braking and is used to inhibit traction control during braking.
causes: Brake light switch failed or misadjusted

C0163.title: Left Rear ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0163.plain: Electrical fault in the outlet solenoid for the left rear wheel. ABS pressure release for this wheel is no longer possible.

C0168.title: Right Rear ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0168.plain: Electrical fault in the inlet solenoid for the right rear wheel. ABS is disabled while the fault is active.

C0173.title: Right Rear ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0173.plain: Electrical fault in the outlet solenoid for the right rear wheel. ABS pressure release for this wheel is no longer possible.

C0185.title: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Range/Performance
C0185.plain: The stability control module has detected that the lateral acceleration sensor signal is out of the expected range or does not match other inertial sensors. ESP and roll-stability functions may be disabled.
causes: Lateral acceleration sensor failed or drifted
Sensor mounting loose or misaligned after body repair

C0186.title: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Circuit
C0186.plain: The stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the lateral acceleration sensor. ESP uses lateral g-force together with yaw rate and steering angle to detect skid conditions — without it, ESP is disabled.
causes: Sensor cluster loose or mounted incorrectly

C0196.title: Yaw Rate Sensor Circuit
C0196.plain: The stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the yaw rate sensor. The yaw sensor measures rotation around the vertical axis and is essential for ESP — a fault disables stability control.
causes: Sensor not calibrated after replacement or alignment

C0200.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Front Left Circuit
C0200.plain: The ABS control module detects a fault in the inlet/outlet solenoid for the front left brake circuit. The valve is integrated in the hydraulic block; replacement is generally a workshop task.
causes: Internal short to ground in valve block

C0201.title: Brake Fluid Level Switch Circuit
C0201.plain: The ABS or brake control module has detected a fault in the brake fluid level switch circuit. A low fluid level indicates a potential leak in the hydraulic system and disables ABS while a separate brake warning lamp is illuminated.
causes: Brake fluid level low (worn pads or hydraulic leak)

C0202.title: Brake Pedal Position Sensor
C0202.plain: The chassis or brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the brake pedal position sensor. Modern brake systems use this sensor for brake assist, regenerative braking and adaptive cruise control functions.

C0203.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Front Right Circuit
C0203.plain: Fault in the front right ABS solenoid (mirror of C0200).

C0205.title: Stop Lamp Switch Circuit
C0205.plain: The ABS or stability control module has detected a fault in the stop lamp switch circuit. The brake light switch tells the module whether the driver is braking and is used to coordinate ABS, traction control and cruise control.
causes: Stop lamp switch failed or misadjusted

C0206.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Rear Left Circuit
C0206.plain: Fault in the rear left ABS solenoid valve.

C0209.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Rear Right Circuit
C0209.plain: Fault in the rear right ABS solenoid valve.

C0220.title: ABS Valve Block Supply Voltage
C0220.plain: Supply voltage to the ABS valve block is out of range, disabling all valve control.

C0225.title: ABS Valve Relay Circuit
C0225.plain: The valve relay supplying the ABS solenoids does not respond as commanded.

C0230.title: Brake Pedal Position Sensor Circuit
C0230.plain: The brake pedal position sensor reports an implausible signal. Required for brake-by-wire and stability control.

C0234.title: Wheel Speed Sensor Frequency Error
C0234.plain: The ABS control module has detected that one of the wheel speed sensor signals has a frequency outside the plausible range, e.g. unrealistically high pulses or signal dropouts at speed. Stability control may be limited.
causes: Tone ring damaged, missing teeth, or contaminated

C0235.title: Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
C0235.plain: The ABS control module has detected an erratic wheel speed sensor signal — sudden jumps or dropouts compared to the other wheels. Typical causes are a damaged tone ring or a loose sensor.
causes: Tone ring damaged or contaminated with metal debris
Wheel speed sensor loose in housing

C0237.title: Loss of Speed Sensor Signal Front Left
C0237.plain: The ABS control module has lost the wheel speed signal from the front left wheel during driving. ABS and stability control are disabled because wheel-individual speed information is required for slip detection.

C0238.title: Speed Wheel-to-Wheel Mismatch
C0238.plain: The ABS control module has detected an implausible speed difference between wheels that cannot be explained by cornering. This typically points to one suspect sensor, mismatched tyre sizes or a damaged tone ring.
causes: Tyre sizes or wear levels do not match across axles
Tone ring missing teeth on one wheel

C0240.title: Brake Pressure Sensor
C0240.plain: The ABS or stability control module has detected a fault in a brake pressure sensor. Pressure information is used by ESP and brake assist to determine driver intent and modulation pressure during regulation.

C0241.title: ABS Warning Lamp Control Circuit
C0241.plain: The ABS warning lamp control circuit is shorted or open. The driver may see a permanently lit or non-functional ABS warning lamp.

C0242.title: PCM Indicated ABS Malfunction
C0242.plain: The powertrain control module reports a fault that the ABS module must consider (e.g. traction control engine torque request fault).

C0244.title: PWM Brake Pressure Modulation Circuit
C0244.plain: The PWM control of the brake pressure modulation valves is faulty.

C0245.title: Wheel Speed Sensor Frequency Mismatch
C0245.plain: The ABS control module has detected that the frequency of one wheel speed sensor signal does not match the others under stable driving conditions. This often indicates a tone ring with extra or missing teeth or a sensor with degraded signal quality.

C0246.title: ABS/TCS Control Module Internal Performance
C0246.plain: Internal plausibility check of the combined ABS/TCS control module fails.

C0250.title: Power Steering Pump Pressure
C0250.plain: The power steering control module has detected an implausible pressure or load signal from the steering pump. On hydraulic systems this may indicate low fluid or a worn pump; on electric systems it may indicate excessive motor load.
causes: Power steering fluid low or contaminated

C0252.title: Pump Motor Ground Circuit Open
C0252.plain: The pump motor ground return is open. The motor cannot run, and the system disables ABS and stability control.
causes: Pin pushed back out of connector body

C0258.title: Brake Booster Vacuum Sensor Circuit
C0258.plain: The brake booster vacuum sensor reports an implausible signal; brake assist functions are reduced. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

C0265.title: EBCM Relay Circuit
C0265.plain: The Electronic Brake Control Module has detected a fault in its main supply relay circuit. Without proper relay supply the EBCM cannot operate the hydraulic unit and ABS as well as stability control are disabled.
causes: Power supply wiring or fuse fault

C0266.title: Active Brake Booster
C0266.plain: The brake control module has detected a fault in the active (electric or vacuum-controlled) brake booster. Active boosters are used by emergency brake assist and adaptive cruise control to autonomously build brake pressure.
causes: Active booster motor or solenoid failed
Vacuum supply weak (vacuum pump or hose fault)

C0267.title: Brake Pump Motor Circuit
C0267.plain: The ABS or brake control module has detected an electrical fault in the brake pump motor circuit. The pump is used to build brake pressure during ABS, ESP and brake-by-wire operations and a fault disables these functions.

C0268.title: Brake Pump Run Time Exceeded
C0268.plain: The brake control module has detected that the brake pump has run longer than the allowed maximum time. This typically indicates the pump cannot reach target pressure due to a hydraulic leak, air in the system or a worn pump.

C0269.title: Brake Vacuum Sensor
C0269.plain: The brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the vacuum sensor on the brake booster. Modern systems monitor booster vacuum to ensure brake assist is available, especially with stop-start engines and electric vacuum pumps.

C0273.title: Brake Booster Pressure Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0273.plain: The brake control module has detected an out-of-range or implausible signal from the brake booster pressure sensor. Brake assist and electronic boost functions may be limited.
causes: Wiring or connector fault to sensor

C0277.title: Brake Booster Vacuum Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0277.plain: The brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the booster vacuum sensor. Loss of vacuum signal can cause hard pedal and reduced power assist.
causes: Vacuum leak in booster or hose

C0279.title: Brake Booster Boost Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0279.plain: The brake control module has detected an electrical fault in the booster boost (assist pressure) sensor circuit. Power-assist regulation may default to a backup strategy.

C0287.title: ESP Performance
C0287.plain: The stability control module has detected that overall ESP performance is degraded — typically a plausibility check between yaw rate, lateral acceleration, steering angle and wheel speeds has failed. ESP is deactivated until the root cause is resolved.
causes: Sensor cluster loose or mounted incorrectly

C0288.title: Yaw Rate Sensor Range
C0288.plain: The stability control module has detected that the yaw rate sensor signal is outside the plausible range during stable driving. This typically indicates a sensor offset, an incorrect mounting or a degraded sensor element.

C0290.title: Brake Pedal Stroke Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0290.plain: The brake control module has detected an out-of-range signal from the brake pedal stroke sensor. Pedal travel information is required for brake assist and electronically boosted braking.
causes: Sensor mounting or pedal linkage misadjusted

C0291.title: Brake Pedal Apply Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0291.plain: Electrical fault in the brake pedal apply sensor circuit. The module cannot reliably detect whether the brake pedal is pressed, which affects ABS, ESP and brake assist functions.

C0295.title: Steering Sensor Indicates Bias
C0295.plain: The stability control module has detected that the steering wheel position sensor reports a non-zero angle when the vehicle is driving straight. This bias makes ESP intervene incorrectly and the system requires recalibration.

C0300.title: Inlet Valve Front Left Performance
C0300.plain: The front left inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected during ABS self-test.
causes: Valve stuck due to brake fluid debris

C0301.title: Air Suspension Compressor Relay
C0301.plain: The air suspension control module has detected a fault in the compressor relay circuit. The compressor cannot be energized which prevents the system from refilling the air struts and ride height drops over time.

C0302.title: Outlet Valve Front Left Performance
C0302.plain: The front left outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0303.title: Inlet Valve Front Right Performance
C0303.plain: The front right inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0304.title: Outlet Valve Front Right Performance
C0304.plain: The front right outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0305.title: Inlet Valve Rear Left Performance
C0305.plain: The rear left inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0306.title: Ride Height Sensor Front Left
C0306.plain: Ride Height Sensor Front Left: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0307.title: Inlet Valve Rear Right Performance
C0307.plain: The rear right inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0308.title: Ride Height Sensor Front Right
C0308.plain: Ride Height Sensor Front Right: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0309.title: Outlet Valve Rear Right Performance
C0309.plain: The rear right outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0310.title: Ride Height Sensor Rear Left
C0310.plain: Ride Height Sensor Rear Left: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0312.title: Ride Height Sensor Rear Right
C0312.plain: Ride Height Sensor Rear Right: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0317.title: Compressor Relay Circuit
C0317.plain: The air suspension control module has detected a circuit fault on the compressor relay output — typically open circuit, short to ground or short to power. Self-levelling is disabled and the vehicle may sit lower than normal.
causes: Compressor motor shorted, dragging supply down

C0327.title: Encoder Motor
C0327.plain: The transfer case control module has detected a fault in the encoder motor used to shift between 2WD and 4WD ranges. A fault prevents range changes and may leave the transfer case in an undefined position.
causes: Encoder motor failed (worn brushes or seized)

C0374.title: 4WD Drive Coupling
C0374.plain: The 4WD or AWD control module has detected a fault on the electronic drive coupling that distributes torque between axles. Reduced torque transfer or a complete loss of all-wheel drive function may result.

C0376.title: Front Axle Disconnect
C0376.plain: The 4WD control module has detected a fault on the front axle disconnect actuator. On part-time AWD vehicles this actuator decouples the front axle for fuel saving, and a fault prevents engagement or disengagement of front-wheel drive.

C0387.title: Transfer Case Position Sensor
C0387.plain: The transfer case control module has detected an implausible signal from the position sensor that reports the current shift position (2HI, 4HI, 4LO, neutral). Without a valid position the system cannot complete a range change.

C0388.title: Transfer Case High Range Switch Circuit Malfunction
C0388.plain: The transfer case control module has detected an implausible state from the high range (4H) position switch. Range selection in 4WD mode may be limited.

C0389.title: Transfer Case Low Range Switch Circuit Malfunction
C0389.plain: The transfer case control module has detected an implausible state from the low range (4L) position switch. Engagement of low range may be inhibited.

C0399.title: 4WD Mode Switch Circuit Malfunction
C0399.plain: The transfer case or 4WD control module has detected an invalid signal from the driver-operated 4WD mode selector. Mode requests from the dashboard may be ignored.

C0400.title: Traction Control Solenoid Valve Circuit
C0400.plain: The dedicated traction control isolation valve in the hydraulic block reports an electrical fault.

C0401.title: Traction Control Switch Circuit
C0401.plain: The TCS on/off switch reports an implausible state.

C0402.title: Traction Control Lamp Circuit
C0402.plain: The TCS indicator lamp control circuit is shorted or open.

C0405.title: Traction Control Active Too Long
C0405.plain: TCS regulation has been continuously active longer than allowed, suggesting persistent low-friction conditions or a sensor fault.

C0410.title: Adaptive Cruise Control Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0410.plain: The adaptive cruise control module has detected a fault in its forward-looking radar or lidar sensor circuit. ACC and forward collision warning are unavailable while the fault is active.
causes: Radar sensor blocked by snow, ice or dirt

C0420.title: Adaptive Cruise Control Module Internal Performance
C0420.plain: The adaptive cruise control module has reported an internal performance fault — for example self-test failure, supply voltage out of range or invalid configuration. ACC is disabled.
causes: Module configuration invalid after part exchange

C0440.title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Circuit
C0440.plain: The steering angle sensor reports an electrical fault. ESC and lane keeping assistance functions are typically disabled.

C0445.title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Calibration
C0445.plain: The steering angle sensor has not been calibrated after a service operation, or the calibration value is implausible.

C0450.title: Rear Wheel Steering Position Sensor Circuit
C0450.plain: On vehicles with active rear wheel steering, the rear position sensor reports an electrical fault. The system disables rear steering.

C0455.title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Circuit
C0455.plain: The chassis or stability control module has detected a fault in the steering wheel position sensor circuit. ESP and lane assist systems require an accurate steering angle and may be deactivated.

C0460.title: Steering Position Signal Implausible
C0460.plain: Steering angle signal is implausible compared with yaw rate, lateral acceleration and wheel speeds.

C0496.title: Yaw Rate Sensor Circuit
C0496.plain: The yaw rate sensor reports an electrical fault. ESC is disabled while the fault is active.

C0497.title: Yaw Rate Sensor Range/Performance
C0497.plain: The yaw rate sensor signal is implausible relative to steering angle and lateral acceleration.
causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0498.title: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Circuit
C0498.plain: The lateral acceleration sensor reports an electrical fault.

C0499.title: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Range/Performance
C0499.plain: The lateral acceleration sensor signal is outside the plausibility range.
causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0500.title: Anti-lock Brake System Disabled
C0500.plain: A general status code indicating that ABS function has been disabled by the brake control module. It is set in addition to the underlying root-cause code that disabled ABS.
causes: Communication bus fault to ABS module

C0501.title: ESC Active Performance
C0501.plain: ESC interventions occur but do not produce the expected vehicle response. May indicate hydraulic or mechanical limitation.

C0502.plain: Left-front wheel speed sensor A signal voltage below expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes: Communication bus fault to brake systems

C0518.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor - Mechanical
C0518.plain: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor - Mechanical: a mechanical fault is present — typically a damaged tone ring, excessive air gap, or loose mounting. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control and the speedometer.

C0519.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor - Mechanical
C0519.plain: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor - Mechanical: a mechanical fault is present — typically a damaged tone ring, excessive air gap, or loose mounting. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control and the speedometer.

C051D.title: Multi-axis Acceleration Sensor Module A Missing Calibration
C051D.plain: Multi-axis acceleration module A is not calibrated — required after replacement or chassis adjustment.

C051E.title: Multi-axis Acceleration Sensor Module A Intermittent/Erratic

causes: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C051F.plain: Acceleration data from module A does not correlate with wheel speed and steering inputs.

C0520.title: Brake Pedal Force Sensor Circuit

C0525.title: Multi-axis Acceleration Sensor Module B

causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C052A.title: Steering Angle Sensor Module Correlation

causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

causes: Pin pushed back out of connector body
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor

C052D.plain: ABS pump motor control voltage above expected range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

C066E.title: Service/Park Brake Chamber Pressure Too High
C066E.plain: Pressure in the service/park brake chamber exceeded safe limit.

C066F.title: Service/Park Brake Chamber Pressure Too Low
C066F.plain: Pressure in the service/park brake chamber dropped below required minimum — risk of insufficient braking force.

C0670.title: Electric Park Brake Actuator Left Circuit
C0670.plain: The left electric park brake caliper actuator does not respond as commanded.

C0671.title: Electric Park Brake Actuator Right Circuit
C0671.plain: The right electric park brake caliper actuator does not respond as commanded.

C0680.title: Electric Park Brake Module Internal Fault
C0680.plain: The EPB control module fails its internal self-test and the park brake function may be limited.

C0700.title: Active Steering Module Communication
C0700.plain: A communication fault between the chassis control module and the active steering module has been detected. Active steering varies the steering ratio with speed, and a fault disables this assistance and may store secondary codes in other modules.
causes: Power supply or ground fault to module

C0710.title: Steering Position Signal Malfunction
C0710.plain: The chassis or stability control module has received an invalid or missing steering position signal — often via the communication bus from the steering control module. ESP, lane assist and electric power steering may be limited.
causes: Steering angle sensor or steering control module failed

C0712.title: Power Steering Position Sensor Range/Performance
C0712.plain: The power steering control module has detected that the rack or column position signal is out of range or implausible. Steering assist may be reduced.
causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0715.title: Power Steering Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
C0715.plain: The power steering module has detected that the hydraulic pressure sensor signal is out of range — relevant for hydraulic and electro-hydraulic systems. Assist regulation may run in fallback mode.
causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0720.title: Electric Power Steering Torque Sensor Circuit
C0720.plain: The torque sensor in the EPS column or rack reports an electrical fault. Power assist is reduced or disabled.

C0725.title: Electric Power Steering Motor Circuit
C0725.plain: The EPS assist motor circuit reports an electrical fault.
causes: Short to ground in motor wiring

C0727.title: Trailer Connector Circuit Malfunction
C0727.plain: The chassis or trailer brake module has detected a fault in the trailer wiring connector — for example open lighting circuit or short to ground. Trailer brake and lighting functions may be unavailable.
causes: Short or open in trailer wiring

C0730.title: Electric Power Steering Motor Position Sensor Circuit
C0730.plain: The EPS motor position sensor (resolver/Hall) reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0735.title: Electric Power Steering Module Internal Fault
C0735.plain: The EPS control module fails its internal self-test. Power assist is disabled.

C0740.title: Electric Power Steering Voltage Supply
C0740.plain: The supply voltage to the EPS module is out of range, reducing or disabling power assist.
causes: Battery undervoltage during high steering load

C0745.title: Electric Power Steering Overtemperature Protection
C0745.plain: The EPS module has reduced or disabled assistance to protect the motor from overheating, typically after extended low-speed manoeuvring.

C0750.title: Cruise Control Brake Switch
C0750.plain: The cruise control or chassis module has detected an implausible signal from the dedicated cruise control brake switch. This switch is independent from the stop lamp switch and disengages cruise control when the driver brakes.
causes: Cruise control brake switch failed or misadjusted

C0784.title: Trailer Brake Force Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0784.plain: The integrated trailer brake controller has detected an electrical fault in the brake force sensor circuit. Proportional trailer brake control is disabled — the controller defaults to a manual or fixed-gain mode.

C0800.title: Drive System Voltage Low
C0800.plain: The chassis control module has detected that the supply voltage is below the operating threshold required for ABS, ESP or steering systems. Many chassis functions are limited or disabled until the voltage returns to a normal range.

C0805.title: Steering Angle Sensor Calibration
C0805.plain: The chassis or stability control module reports that the steering angle sensor has not been calibrated or that the calibration data has been lost. ESP requires a calibrated zero position and is disabled until calibration is performed.
causes: Calibration required after battery disconnect or repair

C0810.title: Air Suspension Compressor Circuit
C0810.plain: The air suspension compressor motor circuit reports an electrical fault. Levelling is disabled.

C0815.title: Air Suspension Compressor Overtemperature
C0815.plain: The air suspension compressor has been disabled to protect against overheating, typically after a slow leak.
causes: Slow leak in air spring or line

C0820.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Front Left
C0820.plain: The front left ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0821.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Front Right
C0821.plain: The front right ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0822.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Rear Left
C0822.plain: The rear left ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0823.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Rear Right
C0823.plain: The rear right ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0825.title: Steering Effort Sensor Range/Performance
C0825.plain: The electric power steering module has detected that the torque (effort) sensor signal is out of the expected range. Steering assist is reduced or disabled.
causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0827.title: Steering Effort Sensor Stuck
C0827.plain: The power steering module has detected that the torque sensor signal does not change despite steering input — the sensor appears stuck. Assist is disabled to avoid uncontrolled steering torque.

C0830.title: Steering Wheel Angle Sensor Center Position Not Learned
C0830.plain: The chassis control module has not stored a valid center (zero) position for the steering wheel angle sensor. ESP, lane assist and electric power steering may be limited until calibration is performed.
causes: Sensor calibration not performed after replacement

C0840.title: Air Suspension Solenoid Valve Circuit
C0840.plain: One of the level control solenoid valves reports an electrical fault. The corresponding axle cannot be levelled.

C0850.title: Active Damping Control Front Left
C0850.plain: The front left adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0851.title: Active Damping Control Front Right
C0851.plain: The front right adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0852.title: Active Damping Control Rear Left
C0852.plain: The rear left adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0853.title: Active Damping Control Rear Right
C0853.plain: The rear right adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0860.title: Trailer Stability Assist Performance
C0860.plain: The trailer stability assist function detects implausible trailer sway response or sensor input.

C0870.title: Adaptive Cruise Control Brake Request Performance
C0870.plain: A brake request from adaptive cruise control or AEB cannot be executed within the expected response time.
causes: Hydraulic block slow to build pressure

C0900.title: TPMS Sensor 1 Battery
C0900.plain: TPMS Sensor 1 Battery: the control module has detected this fault condition.
causes: TPMS sensor battery depleted (end of life)

C0901.title: TPMS Sensor 1 Position Performance
C0901.plain: The tire pressure monitoring receiver cannot reliably localize sensor 1 to a wheel position. Pressure values may be assigned to the wrong wheel until relearn is completed.

C0902.title: TPMS Sensor 2 Battery
C0902.plain: TPMS Sensor 2 Battery: the control module has detected this fault condition.
causes: TPMS sensor battery depleted (end of life)

C0903.title: TPMS Sensor 2 Position Performance
C0903.plain: The tire pressure monitoring receiver cannot reliably localize sensor 2 to a wheel position. Pressure values may be assigned to the wrong wheel until relearn is completed.

C0905.title: TPMS Sensor 3 Battery Low
C0905.plain: The TPMS receiver reports that the internal battery of sensor 3 is at end of life. The sensor must be replaced as the battery is sealed inside the housing.

C0907.title: TPMS Sensor 4 Battery Low
C0907.plain: The TPMS receiver reports that the internal battery of sensor 4 is at end of life. The sensor must be replaced as the battery is sealed inside the housing.

C0910.title: TPMS Receiver Circuit Malfunction
C0910.plain: The body or chassis module has detected a fault in the TPMS RF receiver — for example open antenna or internal failure. No tire pressure data can be received.

C0912.title: TPMS Initiator Front Circuit Malfunction
C0912.plain: The TPMS module has detected an electrical fault in the front low-frequency initiator (used to wake and locate sensors). Position learning of the front sensors fails.

C0915.title: Active Roll Stabilisation Front Actuator Circuit

C0916.title: Active Roll Stabilisation Rear Actuator Circuit

C0920.title: Suspension Control Module Internal Fault

C0950.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Front Left

C0951.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Front Right

C0952.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Rear Left

C0953.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Rear Right
